GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped with its head ion the air then ridden positively early and Settled Down 2.5 Lengths joint Lead on fence, Headed 750m and trailed a half length middle stages, movced back up to 1 length joint Lead on fence turning, railed to sole Lead rounding turn, led 1 length Straightening Up , kept going in Straight and only Headed in the final stride. [Stewards: Fractious in barrier. Underwent pre-race vet exam. Passed suitable to race.] # pipped on post
Jumped Well to lead half clear, pushed along turn, headed Straightening Up and dropped out # led/faded
Jumped Ok sat 4l off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on ok after tough run # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear, ridden along turn, joint lead Straightening Up , headed approaching 100m and gave ground # led/faded
Jumped Ok sat rail 3l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, battled on well, no match winner # had run/sound
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, found little, plodded home # weak run home

Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced 4th Two Wide (3L from lead). Held Ground until pushed out 3 Wide @ 650m & pushed along Four Wide @ 500m. Chasing Five Wide @ 400m & pressured Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Weakened in straight. # Beaten on turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 1300m, threw its head whilst reluctant to settle. Continued to travel keenly throughout the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Best away. Rolled fwd & led on rail by 1.5L early . Held lead on inside midrace & quickened @ 400m. Pushed to quicken Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured & challenged @ 200m. Weakened in last 150m. # Led & weakened.
Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 800m, Hard Ridden on the corner and looked beaten but she dug deep under riding and kept grinding away to hold second spot # brave chase

Away OK. Pushed fwd & worked to share lead 3 Wide early . Worked to narrow lead Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken =lead Four Wide on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & weakened in last 200m. Vetted - mild heat stress. # Worked & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: App. reported that her mount was required to work hard in the early and middle stages of the event and, as a consequence, weakened in the home straight. She added that her mount raced keenly after obtaining the lead position. A post race veterinary examination revealed the mare to have mild heat stress.
